title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E19 — Grumpy Old Man
Mark plays matchmaker to an elderly couple so he can buy a classic car. Geneva worries that no one on the faculty likes her.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E20 — True Confessions
When Vanessa dates a successful, handsome man (WILLIE GAULT), Mark has an unexpected reaction.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E21 — Breaking Up is Hard to Do
Mark and Vanessa date each other, but their relationship encounters trouble immediately.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E22 — Will She Or Won't She?
Mark mistakenly thinks that Eric has proposed to Vanessa so he asks her to marry him. Mark revokes the proposal when he discovers his mistake, but proposes to her again seriously on a scoreboard at a NBA game. Tim Hardaway and Gary Payton guest star.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S5 E1 — The Ring
After convincing Vanessa to marry him, Mark must buy her an engagement ring.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S5 E2 — Please Don't Go
As Mark and Vanessa plan their wedding, Geneva has an unexpected reaction.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S2 E36 — Everybody Hates Hall Monitors
Hoping to get more respect from his classmates and to stop being Caruso's punching bag, Chris signs up to be a hall monitor.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S2 E37 — Everybody Hates Snow Day
When Chris accidentally shows up for school on a "snow day," he and Principal Edwards (Alexander) are stuck with each other until they can reach Chris' parents.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S2 E38 — Everybody Hates Chain Snatching
When Chris thwarts Malvo's attempt at stealing a gold chain from Vanessa, Malvo gives Chris one day - or suffer the consequences - to produce a replacement necklace.
